text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then right here—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, not really... Though I do suspect
this might not be something I should be asking you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um... hmmm.
choice_data_list: I'm all ears, no matter what it is.
I'll listen, no matter what it is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me. Then, if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um, do you know much about games?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's just that Taishin was totally engrossed
in a smartphone game the other day."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She was so deeply engrossed that I ended up snapping, 'Don't you think that's enough?', which led to a bit of an argument.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Though on second thought, whenever I am lost in thought, Taishin waits patiently for me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She understands that it's an important time for me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I thought that I, too,
should first try to understand Taishin's games."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Anyway, back to the main topic.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um, are you knowledgeable about video games?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
After all, it's a field I've never touched before.
Embarrassingly enough, I don't even really know
what kind of games are currently in fashion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you!

And so, I ended up looking into currently popular
smartphone games for Biwa Hayahide's sake.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Looking at them again like this... there really is quite a variety.
I wonder which one I should start with.

When it comes to a game suited for
the serious and meticulous Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've seen this in a commercial before!
Taishin might be playing this too!
And so, Biwa Hayahide, who had started playing the puzzle game...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The next piece to fall
is a vertical yellow one, is it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then, I should place this square piece on the right side and leave space on the left...
Making precise decisions and racking up points—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, game cleared!
We did it, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even if it is a smartphone game,
it is certainly not to be underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, this is truly fascinating!
And it sharpens my concentration!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...Maybe Taishin felt this way too. Hmm."

Later on, Biwa Hayahide approached
Narita Taishin herself, and the two
apparently enjoyed playing a puzzle game together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Come to think of it, the game Taishin was playing might've been that genre too!
And so, Biwa Hayahide ended up playing a racing game, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hop! Turn!
No, no, no! That's not the way I wanna go!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!?
Isn't bumping into me a foul?!

Swaying her body left and right,
Biwa Hayahide thoroughly enjoyed the racing game.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I see, no wonder Taishin is so absorbed in it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Constantly stay aware of the course, calculate acceleration and top speed.
And above all else, read your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Getting an unprompted, relentless lecture mid-race
would definitely be distracting.
...I can understand why Taishin got mad at me.

Later on, Biwa Hayahide went to apologize
to Narita Taishin, and the two apparently
enjoyed playing a racing game together afterwards.
